expect: premise false: PVDF is barely soluble in Cyrene below 80 °C; separation was run at 100 °C with hot filtration/centrifugation (p3.L14, p4.L10-12, p4.L33-37)
question: Why did the authors run the Cyrene-based separation at room temperature?
rendered: The authors did not run the Cyrene-based separation at room temperature. In fact, they found that the PVDF binder was barely soluble in Cyrene below 80 °C, and clear solutions were formed for both 0.5 and 5 wt% PVDF/Cyrene at 100 °C.
